heritage.description:
Switches on every ASIG protected-heritage layer at once: cultural protected sites (points and polygons), natural protected areas and natural monuments, plus every archaeological zone the geoportal publishes (found by the keyword archaeolog*/archeolog*/arkeolog* in the WMS layer list, exactly as in the owner’s prototype). One opacity slider controls all parts; map clicks query all of them.
[OWNER PLACEHOLDER: legal notice about protected areas to be written by the site owner. These layers show protected zones only — they are not a permission map.]

panelEntries.note: ONE panel toggle; its WMS parts are the layers[] entries with heritagePart:true plus every capabilities layer matching the keyword at runtime. Parts are never panel rows.
